description: A React component named DetailsViewer that renders detailed, structured views of data objects, with features like collapsible sections, formatted fields, raw JSON toggle, and agent-specific interactions.

methods.name: safePretty
methods.description: Returns a pretty-printed JSON string of the payload, with fallback to string conversion or error message.

methods.name: toLabel
methods.description: Converts a key to a formatted label using formatLabel utility.

methods.name: isTimestampLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a timestamp field.

methods.name: isTokenLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a token count field.

methods.name: isDurationLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a duration or latency field.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a human-readable duration string.

methods.name: isCurrencyKeyLoose
methods.description: Determines if a key name loosely indicates a currency or cost field.

methods.name: formatValueByKey
methods.description: Formats a value based on its associated key, applying special formatting for currency, tokens, timestamps, durations, or numbers.

methods.name: initialCollapsed
methods.description: Determines if a section should be collapsed initially based on depth and collapsedDepth prop.

methods.name: Collapser
methods.description: A React component that renders a collapsible section with toggle button.

methods.name: renderPrimitiveVal
methods.description: Renders a primitive value with appropriate formatting and styling.

methods.name: extractAgentIdentity
methods.description: Extracts agent ID and name from an object, used for agent array rendering.

methods.name: renderNode
methods.description: Recursively renders a data node, handling arrays, objects, and primitives with collapsible sections.

methods.name: renderEntries
methods.description: Renders object entries as a list with labels and values, ordering highlighted keys first.
